WITH matched_records AS (
  SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM matched_records
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(type_count) as total_records,
    AVG(CAST(type_count AS REAL)) as avg_per_type
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(tc.tradekind, 'No Type') as trader_type,
  tc.type_count,
  CAST(tc.type_count AS REAL) / s.total_records as proportion,
  tc.type_count - s.avg_per_type as count_above_average
FROM type_counts tc
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE tc.type_count > s.avg_per_type
  AND s.avg_per_type IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tc.type_count DESC
